tasks.deeper-literature-response: Generate Grade 6 English HL multiple-choice questions on deeper literature response. Focus on theme, mood, character motivation, review-style questions, interview-style responses, sequencing, and book response skills. Use short reading situations and ask learners to justify opinions with textual support or choose the strongest evidence.
tasks.extended-writing-speaking: Generate Grade 6 English HL multiple-choice questions on extended writing and speaking. Focus on book reviews, narrative essays, interviews, oral responses, audience awareness, organisation, detail, hooks, and suitable openings and closings. Ask learners to choose structures, details, and delivery choices that fit purpose and audience.
tasks.complex-sentence-work: Generate Grade 6 English HL multiple-choice questions on phrases, clauses, conjunctions, compound sentences, and complex sentences. Include joining and splitting sentences, clause identification, correcting sentence errors, and improving sentence variety in authentic writing contexts.
